verdict.rationale: LobeHub ships official desktop and mobile apps alongside its web workspace (downloads page). The desktop app documents capabilities well beyond chat, including installing local MCP connectors, an integrated terminal, tabs, and the Tasks/Notes composer and dashboard shared with the web app. Missing for 10: any documentation of the mobile app's feature set or parity with web/desktop beyond a tagline, explicit cross-surface parity statements, and independent hands-on corroboration of the desktop or mobile apps.
